name: Rosemary Beach

dates.note: Wikipedia: 'The town was founded in 1995 by Patrick D. Bienvenue, President of Leucadia Financial Corporation, and was designed by Duany Plater-Zyberk & Company'; DPZ's project page: '1995 Designed', 105 ac., 800 units, 55,000 sq.ft. retail.

refs.title: Rosemary Beach (DPZ CoDesign project page)
refs.note: Planner. 'Eschewing Seaside’s Key West pastel clapboard look, Rosemary favored more masonry and adopted a darker wood-stain palette' and 'Unique aesthetic: Caribbean + St. Augustine + earth-tone palette'.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. A town; DPZ's page locates it at 'South Walton, Florida'.
